subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should the public `resolvePollMaxSelections` helper reject zero- and one-option input immediately, matching `normalizePollInput`, rather than preserving its current invalid-input return values?
rationale: This is a behavior change in an exported plugin SDK helper: correctness favors early validation, but external plugin callers may currently rely on the returned value even for invalid polls.

options.title: Accept early validation
options.body: Merge the patch and document the thrown minimum-two-options error as the canonical invalid-input behavior for this helper.

options.title: Preserve helper compatibility
options.body: Keep the helper’s historical return behavior and enforce the invariant only through `normalizePollInput` or a new explicitly validated API path.

recommendation.title: Accept early validation
recommendation.body: Merge the patch and document the thrown minimum-two-options error as the canonical invalid-input behavior for this helper.
